skill_name: Summarize the major differences between inherited traits and learned behaviors
workflow: Inherited traits are characteristics that are passed down from parent to offspring and are determined by genes. Learned behaviors, on the other hand, are behaviors that are acquired by an individual based on habits, environment and experiences. Inherited traits are typically not influenced by the environment, while learned behaviors are heavily influenced by environmental factors. Inherited traits can include physical characteristics, such as eye color, or mental characteristics, such as persona
